title: selenicereus triangularis
intro: Selenicereus triangularis, commonly known as the Night-Blooming Cereus, is a species of cactus that belongs to the family Cactaceae and is native to Mexico and Central America. The plant is known for its unique, trumpet-shaped flowers that bloom at night, emitting a sweet fragrance that attracts pollinators. The health benefits of Selenicereus triangularis include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve sleep quality, while its therapeutic actions include its use as a sedative and anti-anxiety agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have been reported to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
